camel_example: aliyun sls GET /context-models --region cn-hangzhou --size 20 --name order --page 1 --keyword order --projectName 'cn-hangzhou-app-logs' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
kebab_example: aliyun sls list-context-models --page 1 --size 20 --name order --keyword order --project-name cn-hangzhou-app-logs --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListContextModels

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value starts from 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of ContextModel resources to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的 ContextModel 数量，取值范围为 1~1000
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The keyword used for fuzzy filtering by name. This parameter matches only the name and does not match the description. It can be combined with the keyword parameter
parameters.help_zh: 用于模糊过滤的名称关键词，仅匹配名称、不匹配描述。可与 keyword 叠加
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The keyword used for fuzzy filtering. This parameter matches the name, display name, and description
parameters.help_zh: 用于模糊过滤的关键词，同时匹配名称、显示名与描述
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: Queries by reference relationship. Only ContextModel resources that reference the specified project in `sources` are returned. This parameter is used to check which ContextModel resources reference a specific project. The value must be the full project name and is processed by exact match without fuzzy matching. For example, if you specify `order-prod`, models that only reference `order-prod-canary` are not returned. The value must be a valid project name. Otherwise, a 400 error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 按引用关系查询：只返回 `sources` 中引用了该 Project 的 ContextModel，用于查看某个 Project 被哪些 ContextModel 引用。取值为完整的 Project 名，按精确匹配处理，不做模糊匹配 —— 例如传入 `order-prod` 时，仅引用了 `order-prod-canary` 的模型不会被返回。取值需为合法的 Project 名，否则返回 400
parameters.name: project_name

schema.description_en: The response body. Returns a paginated list of context model summaries
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回分页的上下文模型摘要列表

items.description_en: The list of context model summaries on the current page, sorted in descending order of update time. If no matches are found or the page number is out of bounds, an empty array [] is returned. The summaries do not include `sources` and `updatedAt`. To obtain complete information, call GetContextModel
items.description_zh: 当前页的上下文模型摘要列表，按更新时间倒序排列；无命中或页码越界时返回空数组 []。摘要中不含 sources 与 updatedAt，如需完整信息请调用 GetContextModel

items.description_en: The summary information of a single context model
items.description_zh: 单个上下文模型的摘要信息

createdAt.description_en: The time when the model was created. The time is in RFC 3339 UTC format, such as 2026-07-09T05:33:37Z
createdAt.description_zh: 模型创建时间，RFC3339 UTC 格式，形如 2026-07-09T05:33:37Z

description.description_en: The description of the model. The description can be up to 1,024 characters in length. If no description is specified, an empty string "" is returned
description.description_zh: 模型描述，最长 1024 个字符；未填写时返回空串 ""
description.example: End-to-end coverage from order creation to payment

displayName.description_en: The display name. If no display name is set, an empty string `""` is returned, and the value is not backfilled with `name`. When displaying the name, use `displayName || name` as a fallback
displayName.description_zh: 显示名。未设置时返回空串 `""`（不会回填成 `name`），展示时请按 `displayName || name` 回退
displayName.title_zh: 显示名。未设置时返回空串 `""`（不会回填成 `name`），展示时请按 `displayName || name` 回退。

name.description_en: The identifier of the context model. The identifier is unique within the same Alibaba Cloud account and cannot be modified after creation. It can be passed as a path parameter to operations such as GetContextModel
name.description_zh: 上下文模型的标识，在同一主账号下唯一，创建后不可修改；可作为路径参数传给 GetContextModel 等接口

page.description_en: The actual page number that takes effect. If the specified page number is less than 1, it is processed as 1
page.description_zh: 本次实际生效的页码。页码小于 1 时按 1 处理

size.description_en: The actual page size that takes effect. If the specified value is less than 1, the default value 20 is used. If the specified value is greater than 1000, it is processed as 1000
size.description_zh: 本次实际生效的每页条数。小于 1 时按默认值 20 处理，大于 1000 时按 1000 处理

total.description_en: The total number of context models that meet the filter conditions. This value is not affected by pagination
total.description_zh: 满足本次过滤条件的上下文模型总数，不受分页影响
